subject: Third-party failover proof and restore ownership handoff
messages:
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vaultpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-security@vaultpay.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: third-party failover evidence and ownership

Hi Karthik,

As part of our SIG intake ahead of our Q4 SOC 2 refresh, Security Ops at VaultPay is collecting evidence that third-party vendors (specifically inference vendors) have documented failover procedures and a clear ownership handoff for restore operations. We need the following:

- A matrix that shows which Redwood services depend on third-party components (KV cache, logging ingestion, S3/backup) and the responsible owner for failover/restore.
- RTO and RPO commitments for those components (both nominal and warm-standby times).
- Evidence that key-holder rotation and emergency access escalation have been exercised (logs or a summary of drills).
- A short plan for a live witness (30–45 minutes) where your ops team walks our auditors through an end-to-end simulated restore for a single tenant.

Can you share the matrix and any runbook excerpts we can include in the SIG packet? I attached our VaultPay_BCP_Q3_SIG.xlsx with the fields we need filled.

Thanks — Ravi

--
Ravi Menon
Head of Security Operations
VaultPay
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vaultpay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: third-party failover evidence and ownership

Ravi — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise deliverable set and proposing next steps. Attachment: redwood_thirdparty_failover_matrix_v1.pdf (matrix + owner roster).

Summary (high level):
- KV cache (internal Redis cluster + optional external managed cache): Primary owner: Priyom Das (Ops). RTO: 15m (warm cache), RPO: <30s for sharded KV for active tenants; cold restore path RTO: 4h.
- Backup & object store (S3): Primary owner: Laura Bennett (SRE/Storage). RTO: 2h for per-tenant object restoration; RPO: eventual consistency (last snapshot 1h).
- Telemetry ingestion (third-party stream): Owner: Platform Reliability team (Priyom deputy: Laura). RTO: 30m (message replay window 2h).

Key-holder rotation and drills: We ran a scoped failover rehearsal on 2027-07-12 (ops ticket RW-7213). The drill notes and participant log are summarized in the attached runbook excerpt. We will provide filtered audit logs for the event (redacted user ids) together with timeline markers.

Live witness: We can host a 45-minute session on either 2027-09-20 09:00–09:45 PT or 2027-09-22 13:00–13:45 PT. The session will:
- Show failover initiation (triggering warm-standby),
- Walk through KV cache prefilling and validation,
- Execute a single-tenant restore from snapshot,
- Verify application-level correctness and latency SLA post-restore.

Next steps I propose:
1) We’ll fill your VaultPay_BCP_Q3_SIG.xlsx with the entries from our matrix and return by EOD Sep 15.
2) Priyom and Laura will prepare the runbook excerpt and the sanitized drill logs.
3) Confirm one live-witness window and we’ll send a calendar invite + Zoom.

Attachments: redwood_thirdparty_failover_matrix_v1.pdf

Regards,
Karthik
Head of Customer Security (on rotation)
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vaultpay.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: third-party failover evidence and ownership — ops details

Ravi — adding the operational detail you requested and attaching the runbook excerpt. Attachment: runbook-restore-playbook-20270712.md (excerpt).

Operational clarifications:
- The warm cache path uses a controlled KV prefill. Pre-warming is automated using cached prefixes and our snapshot TTL rules; mean prefill time observed in production tests: 12–18 minutes for 95th percentile.
- We maintain a documented key-holder rotation schedule (monthly) and an escalation roster (pager → on-call lead → SRE manager). The rotation summary for Q2–Q3 is included in the attached excerpt.
- For audits: we can provide a sanitized audit timeline (CSV) for the 2027-07-12 rehearsal (includes ticket id, operator id [hashed], and timeline markers). If you prefer, we can redact operator ids but keep role/title mapping.

Security note: Because the CSV includes operational timestamps, we’ll deliver the sanitized file via the secure document transfer link in the DocuSign packet rather than attaching in-line.

Let us know which live-witness window you prefer.

— Priyom
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vaultpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: third-party failover evidence and ownership — confirmation

Thanks Karthik and Priyom — this is exactly what we needed. Two quick asks before we close the SIG packet:

1) Please populate the VaultPay_BCP_Q3_SIG.xlsx with the matrix rows and return by tomorrow (2027-09-17 EOD).
2) We will accept the 2027-09-22 13:00–13:45 PT live witness. I’m sending a DocuSign attestation packet to the primary contact on your side (Karthik) — the powerform will include an option to request the secure transfer of the sanitized audit CSV.

Once we have the signed attestation and the completed spreadsheet, VaultPay’s security ops will mark the control as satisfied for this review cycle.

Ravi
Head of Security Operations
VaultPay
